meta.notes: DRAFT by Claude (s348) for Ben. KYOTO = an OLD SAMURAI-AGE JAPANESE TOWN in CHERRY BLOSSOM season (Ben s348). Old-style Japanese buildings only: wooden machiya townhouses with lattice fronts, temples with sweeping tiled roofs + upturned eaves, a white 5-roof castle keep, thatched farmhouses, red torii gates, stone lanterns, paper lanterns, noren curtains. A red-lacquer TOWN SQUARE (stage, notice board, go board, tea mat) on the crossing of LANTERN STREET (E-W) + SHRINE STREET (N-S). N: the Temple + Onsen above the square; the CASTLE APPROACH (a tunnel of red torii) to Kyoto Castle + the Samurai Barracks (kendo yard). E: the cherry-pink MOUNTAIN ROAD (archery range, shrines, the Sage's Hut) to UNDER THE MOUNTAIN + THE HIDEOUT cave. W: the SUMO APPROACH to the Dohyo. S: houses, rice terraces, THE KITSUNE WOOD (moonlit kitsune clearing: fire, stone, wedding table, chest) → KITSUNE BEACH (sea, dock with 2 boats), the Kyoto Space Dock. CHERRY TREES (terrain.forests mix "cherry") line the roads + hills. SAMURAI + SUMO AVATARS come later at the merge (main project): keep stand-ins. EVERY BUILDING IS UNIQUE ("outside" note), roof sign + eye-level door sign.

buildings.label: Temple
buildings.note: Incense hall: altar in an apse, pulpit, candles, braziers. The abbot (keeps the door to the hot spring), 6 monks, 2 acolytes.
buildings.outside: A two-storey Buddhist temple hall: deep sweeping double roof with upturned eaves in grey tile, red lacquer pillars, a big bronze bell in a little bell tower beside it, stone lanterns lining the steps.

buildings.label: Onsen
buildings.note: Reception, towels, lockers, GREAT POOL, plunge, steam room.
buildings.outside: Low dark-timber bathhouse with steam rising from a garden courtyard, a hanging blue noren curtain with the ♨ hot-spring sign, a bamboo fence and stone path.

buildings.label: Teahouse
buildings.note: Bar counter, TEA minigame (tea master), GEISHA DANCE (Suzu), GO (old master), jukebox, ping-pong, darts. UNIQUE TAVERN GAME: LIAR'S DICE in the sake house.
buildings.outside: Two-storey machiya teahouse: wooden lattice front, red paper lanterns along the eaves, an upper balcony with sliding paper screens, a sake barrel stack by the door.

buildings.label: Armourer
buildings.note: Counter, forge, anvil, quench, shield wall, armour stands, dummies.
buildings.outside: Samurai smithy: black-timber walls, a smoking forge chimney, a suit of red samurai armour on a stand by the door, crossed katanas on the roof board.

buildings.label: Foxy Maki
buildings.note: Ring-shaped SUSHI BAR under four lanterns, NOW HIRING (shift job). Sushi chef + 5 diners.
buildings.outside: UNIQUE RESTAURANT: sushi house with a blue noren curtain, a giant wooden fish sign (a carp) on the roof, four red lanterns over the door, a sake-barrel bench.

buildings.label: Foxy Gyoza
buildings.outside: Little street dumpling stand-house: a yellow cloth awning, bamboo steamer baskets stacked steaming in the window, a giant gyoza dumpling sign.

buildings.label: Library
buildings.note: Six SCROLL ROWS (kitsune legends), catalogue, lectern, globes.
buildings.outside: Tall storehouse library (kura style): white plaster walls, black tiled roof, small barred windows, scroll racks visible through a round moon window.

buildings.label: Theatre
buildings.note: Rows of seats, curtain, lanterns; NOH minigame THE FOX WIFE (wife, farmer, fox masks). The old actor + 5 audience. NOH STAGE (NOT BUILT YET).
buildings.outside: Kabuki-style theatre: a tall curved gable roof, a row of red + white banners on poles out front, painted fox-mask posters, a drum tower.

buildings.label: Lantern Row Lodgings
buildings.note: One rentable room: futon bed + chest. The landlady, Hiro (the boy, grown).
buildings.outside: Wooden row lodging house: two storeys of sliding doors, a long veranda with hanging lanterns, a little stone garden at the door. The player's rentable room is upstairs.

buildings.label: Tea Ceremony House
buildings.outside: UNIQUE SPECIALTY SHOP: a tiny thatched tea hut in a moss garden, a low crawl-in door, stepping stones, a stone water basin with a bamboo ladle.

buildings.label: Go Club
buildings.outside: Quiet club house with a giant Go board carved on its front wall (black + white stones), sliding shoji doors, a pine bonsai on the step.

buildings.label: Fox Gate Pachinko
buildings.outside: The one loud building: a pachinko parlour behind an old wooden front, glowing paper lanterns in pink + gold, a giant silver ball rolling round a fox-gate sign on the roof.

buildings.label: Capsule Corner
buildings.outside: Tiny corner shop with a wall of gachapon capsule machines out front, a giant capsule on the roof, paper streamers.

buildings.label: Rice Exchange
buildings.outside: Rice-merchant counting house: a heavy fire-proof white kura with black corners, an iron-studded door, straw rice bales stacked outside, a big abacus sign.

buildings.label: Galactic Post Office (Meru Embassy)
buildings.outside: Old relay station: stable stalls for runners, a wooden bell tower + the Meru flag, the Galactic Post dish hidden in a pine tree on the roof.

buildings.label: Magistrate's Watch
buildings.outside: Magistrate's office: a black wooden gate with iron studs, a tall watch-fire lookout, wanted scrolls on a board by the gate.

buildings.label: Fire Watch
buildings.outside: Fire brigade hall with a tall wooden fire-watch tower (hanging alarm bell + ladder), red hikeshi banners, water buckets stacked in pyramids.

buildings.label: The Kawaraban
buildings.outside: News print shop: woodblock print boards hung outside to dry, a crier's platform with a drum, paper streamers.

buildings.label: Herb Infirmary
buildings.outside: Herb doctor's house: white walls, a medicinal herb garden, drying herb bundles under the eaves, a red cross lantern, the medevac helipad beside it.

buildings.label: Kyoto Castle
buildings.note: Tatami throne room: throne on a dais, red answer line, advisors, court benches. Emperor, general in red, new empress, girl with a tray, guards.
buildings.outside: The grandest building: a tall white JAPANESE CASTLE KEEP of 5 stacked roofs with upturned eaves and gold shachi fish on the ridge, on a sloping stone base, a red gate in front.

buildings.label: Samurai Barracks
buildings.note: Armour racks, desk, dorm with beds, YARD with KENDO duel ring (vs the general's second).
buildings.outside: Long samurai house with a black-tile roof, a yard with a KENDO ring + wooden practice posts, banners with the house crest.

buildings.label: The Dohyo
buildings.note: Raked-sand clay circle with a rope ring; 6-bout SUMO ladder (Jonokuchi to Ozeki). Stablemaster, the champion (Yugga).
buildings.outside: UNIQUE SPORT: the sumo hall: a big wooden hall with a hanging shrine-style roof inside the tall entrance, purple banners with wrestlers' names on tall poles, drum tower.

buildings.label: Bow & Blade
buildings.note: SPECIAL WEAPONS: the 8 extra ranged + melee
buildings.outside: Dark lacquer shop with bows + naginata racked under the eaves, a giant arrow through the roof board.

buildings.label: The Fox Shrine Shop
buildings.note: The famous Kyoto relic to BUY (DRAFT: Ben picks)
buildings.outside: A tiny shop under its own small red torii gate, white fox statues either side of the door, ema prayer plaques hanging outside.

buildings.label: Rickshaw Stand
buildings.outside: Open wooden shed with rickshaws + a palanquin lined up, a paper-lantern sign, a stable for the DRAGON HATCHLING round the back.

buildings.label: Machiya House
buildings.outside: Narrow townhouse with wooden lattice + a tiny red lantern.

buildings.label: Thatched Farmhouse
buildings.outside: Thick-thatched minka farmhouse with a smoke hole, a persimmon tree.

buildings.label: Garden House
buildings.outside: House with a raked-stone garden + a koi pond out front.

buildings.label: Rice Terraces
buildings.outside: A big thatched farmhouse at the foot of stepped RICE PADDY terraces, a water wheel, scarecrows in straw hats.

buildings.label: The Sage's Hut
buildings.note: Hearth, kettle, table, bunks, chest, woodpile. The sage of the mountain.
buildings.outside: One-room mountain hut of rough timber + bark roof weighed with stones, smoke from a single hearth hole.

buildings.label: General Store
buildings.outside: Old dry-goods merchant house: indigo noren curtains, sake barrels + straw bundles stacked outside, a hanging wooden sign shaped like a rice bowl.
buildings.note: Heal Beam Battery, Energy Cell, rice balls, tea (DRAFT keeper).

look.notes: CHERRY BLOSSOM SPRING in OLD SAMURAI-AGE JAPAN (Ben s348): soft blue sky to a pink-blush horizon, pink petals drifting on the wind, cherry trees everywhere (pink + pale pink), a few dark pines. Old-style Japanese buildings: dark timber, white plaster, grey-black tile roofs with upturned eaves, red lacquer torii + pillars, stone + paper lanterns (warm orange at night). Mount behind the town with a snowy cap. THE KITSUNE WOOD (south) stays MOONLIT even by day: deep blue shade, glowing fox-fire wisps, lanterns along the path, then KITSUNE BEACH: pale sand, a calm moonlit sea, the dock with 2 boats, a red torii in the shallows.

terrain.notes: KYOTO = a valley town at the foot of a holy MOUNTAIN (east). The town, the streets and the castle approach stay flat. Gentle cherry hills ring the town; the mountain rises past the Mountain Road with the shrine stair + platform; the river valley Under the Mountain runs north-south at its foot.
